skills.name: content-types
skills.description: Maps a filename, bare extension, pathlib.Path, or URL to its MIME / content type by table lookup alone, never reading the file, and maps a content type or raw Content-Type header back to a file extension. Use when Python code needs a Content-Type header or S3 ContentType for a file it has not opened, names a download from a response header, gets application/octet-stream and must tell a miss from a real binary, chooses between treat_as_binary, fallback, and fallback=None, hits TypeError "filename cannot be None", would otherwise reach for the stdlib mimetypes module, or runs the content-types CLI.
